https://www.inquirer.net/495812/ridon-we.body: In a statement, Ridon said: “With the opening of the Asean [Association of Southeast Asian Nations] Summit today, it is important to clarify: The West Philippine Sea belongs to the Philippines. The West Philippine Sea is for the Filipinos.” “Although we have relations with China in different aspects, from diplomatic, economic, trade, cultural, and other areas, there is a red line in discussions about the WPS,” he added. Ridon issued the statement as Asean member states meet again to discuss several matters, including security concerns over the region, especially since several nations have claimed ownership of different portions of the South China Sea. “Ang sovereign rights of the WPS, the use of resources under the seabed, islands, and waters of the WPS are for the Philippines only. These are for Filipinos only,” he noted. The Philippines is hosting the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits from Nov. 15 to 17, for regional leaders to discuss key political, security, and economic issues. The main events will be held at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City. Chinese President Xi Jingping will not attend, but Premier Li Qiang will be in Manila for the summit. Li’s attendance, however, comes as Manila and Beijing’s ties were strained due to tensions over the disputed portions of the South China Sea, and the Chinese Embassy in the Philippines’ dispute with several local officials, including Philippine lawmakers. Last October, some members of the Philippine House of Representatives called out Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan for saying that while China can easily win in a military contest, it seeks a peaceful resolution to the dispute. READ: China can ‘easily win’ using force, but wants peace, says envoy to PH The envoy warned that the Philippines faced a greater risk of confrontation if it did not reestablish direct military-to-military communications, which have been suspended by Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. for about three years now. According to members of the House’s Young Guns bloc, true peace will not be attained if one side makes threats, saying that Jing’s statements carry a threat, not an assurance of peace. “Threat is not an assurance of peace,” Deputy Speaker Paolo Ortega V said last Oct. 16. “When a larger power tells a smaller nation that it could easily win if it chose force, it is not offering security. It is asserting dominance and expecting silence in return. That is the opposite of peace.” READ: Solons to Chinese envoy: No peace if one party uses threats Due to this squabble, former Surigao del Norte Rep. Robert Ace Barbers and Mamamayang Liberal Party-list Rep. Leila de Lima separately warned the Philippines about the possibility of China suddenly playing negotiator when Asean member-states convene for the 49th summit. Barbers said last Oct. 29 that Philippine authorities should be wary of the possible “double-talk” from China, noting that it cannot be a good negotiator if it cannot even peacefully settle differences over the WPS. The former lawmaker clarified that he is not prejudging China’s intentions. Rather, he would prefer authorities to be on guard, considering the said country’s aggressive actions over disputed waters. In 2016, the Permanent Court of Arbitration (PCA) ruled in its award that the Philippines has exclusive rights over its waters, including the WPS, as China’s nine-dash line claim lacks legal or historical basis. This means that the WPS, a body of water that forms part of the South China Sea, belongs to the Philippines as it sits inside the country’s exclusive economic zone. China has insisted, however, on ownership of many islands inside the WPS, despite the award. Philippine-Chinese ties recovered during the administration of President Rodrigo Duterte, who once called the PCA award a piece of paper that can be thrown in the waste bin. But since President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. assumed office in 2022, relations have been strained again, as his administration insists that the Philippines will not cede an inch of its territory to foreign powers. Several incidents between the two countries’ water assets have been well-documented: just this July, the Armed Forces of the Philippines reported that a Navy man was injured after members of the Chinese Coast Guard (CCG) assaulted him during a confrontation at Ayungin Shoal. https://www.inquirer.net/495812/ridon-we.body_zh: 在一份声明中，Ridon表示：“随着东盟[东南亚国家联盟]峰会今天开幕，有必要澄清：西菲律宾海属于菲律宾。西菲律宾海属于菲律宾人。”他补充说：“虽然我们与中国在外交、经济、贸易、文化及其他领域都有关系，但在有关西菲律宾海的讨论中有一条红线。”东盟成员国再次会晤，讨论包括地区安全关切在内的多项事务，尤其是因为多个国家声称南海不同部分的所有权。Ridon是在这一背景下发表声明的。他指出：“西菲律宾海的主权权利、海床下的资源以及西菲律宾海内的岛屿和海域，只属于菲律宾。这些只属于菲律宾人。”菲律宾正主办11月15日至17日举行的第49届东盟峰会及相关峰会，供地区领导人讨论重要的政治、安全和经济问题。主要活动将在帕赛市的菲律宾国际会议中心举行。中国国家主席习近平不会出席，但国务院总理李强将赴马尼拉参加峰会。然而，在马尼拉与北京因南海争议海域紧张局势而关系趋紧之际，中国驻菲律宾大使馆与包括菲律宾议员在内的多名地方官员发生争执，而李强的出席恰逢此时。去年10月，菲律宾众议院部分议员指责中国驻菲律宾大使景泉，称尽管中国在军事对抗中很容易获胜，但寻求和平解决争端。阅读：中国可用武力“轻易获胜”，但希望和平，该国驻菲律宾大使警告说 这位大使警告，如果菲律宾不恢复直接军事沟通，对抗风险将更大；菲律宾国防部长Gilberto Teodoro Jr.已经暂停这种沟通约三年。据众议院“青年枪手”集团成员称，如果一方发出威胁，真正的和平就无法实现；他们表示，景泉的言论是一种威胁，而不是和平保证。众议院副议长Paolo Ortega V于去年10月16日说：“威胁不是和平保证。当一个更大的强国告诉一个小国，如果它选择使用武力就很容易获胜时，它提供的不是安全，而是在宣示支配地位，并期待对方保持沉默。这与和平背道而驰。”阅读：议员向中国特使表示，一方使用威胁就不会有和平 由于这场纷争，前北苏里高省众议员Robert Ace Barbers和自由党-list众议员Leila de Lima分别警告菲律宾，在东盟成员国举行第49届峰会之际，要防范中国突然扮演谈判者的可能。Barbers于去年10月29日表示，菲律宾当局应当警惕中国可能发出的“两面话”，并指出，如果中国连西菲律宾海的分歧都不能以和平方式解决，就不可能成为合格的谈判者。这位前议员澄清，他并非预判中国的意图，而是希望当局保持警惕，因为该国在争议水域采取了强硬行动。2016年，常设仲裁法院（PCA）在其裁决中认定，菲律宾对其水域拥有专属权利，包括西菲律宾海，因为中国的“九段线”主张缺乏法律或历史依据。这意味着西菲律宾海作为南海的一部分，位于菲律宾专属经济区内，因此属于菲律宾。然而，尽管有该项裁决，中国仍坚称拥有西菲律宾海内许多岛屿的所有权。菲律宾总统Rodrigo Duterte执政期间，菲中关系有所恢复；他曾称PCA裁决不过是一张可以扔进垃圾桶的废纸。但自总统Ferdinand Marcos Jr.于2022年就任以来，两国关系再次紧张，因为其政府坚持菲律宾不会向外国力量让出任何领土。两国海上力量之间的数起事件已有充分记录：就在今年7月，菲律宾武装部队报告称，在Ayungin Shoal发生的一场冲突中，中国海警局（CCG）人员袭击了一名海军人员，导致其受伤。阅读：议员称，中国在水域问题上表现得像“并骑作案”的罪犯 2023年8月，中国海警局船只向菲律宾船只使用水炮，而菲律宾船只当时只是试图向BRP Sierra Madre上的士兵运送物资。您的订阅无法保存。请重试。您的订阅已成功。针对这一事件，中国声称，前一届政府曾承诺将BRP Sierra Madre撤出Ayungin，但该承诺尚未落实。Marcos随后表示，他本人没有达成这项协议；如果存在这样的协议，也已经终止。/atm 如需全面报道和深入分析，请访问我们关于西菲律宾海最新动态的专题页面。通过文章、视频和专家观点了解最新信息

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: South Korea's presidential office said Sunday it is considering life imprisonment without parole as part of an initiative aimed at strengthening public safety and cracking down on crimes targeting vulnerable people. The initiative will focus on crimes targeting socially vulnerable people, including relationship-based crimes and crimes with apparently random motives. The government will also step up efforts to eradicate crimes involving scams, illegal drugs, illegal private lending, digital sex crimes and false or fabricated information, among other offenses that disrupt people's daily lives or threaten public order, presidential chief of staff Lim Kwang-hyun said. Lim said the initiative follows instructions from President Lee Jae Myung at a Cabinet meeting last week to concentrate government-wide resources on protecting people's lives and making daily life safer. "In cases involving economic harm that exploit people's desperate circumstances, we will pursue those responsible even overseas, dismantle the criminal operations at their source and block criminal proceeds," Lim said at a briefing. Under current law, inmates serving life sentences may be considered for parole after serving 20 years. In 2023, the Cabinet approved a bill to amend the Criminal Act to introduce life imprisonment without parole as a means of permanently isolating perpetrators of heinous crimes from society. The proposal would have allowed courts to distinguish between life sentences with and without the possibility of parole. The bill failed to pass the 21st National Assembly before its term expired in May 2024
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 总统办公室考虑在公共安全举措中引入终身不得假释制度
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国总统府周日表示，正在考虑将不得假释的无期徒刑纳入一项旨在加强公共安全、打击针对弱势人员犯罪的计划。该计划将重点打击针对社会弱势人员的犯罪，包括涉及人际关系关系的犯罪以及表面上动机随机的犯罪。总统府首席秘书林光贤表示，政府还将加大力度铲除涉及诈骗、非法毒品、非法私人放贷、数字性犯罪以及虚假或捏造信息的犯罪，并整治其他扰乱民众日常生活或威胁公共秩序的违法行为。林表示，这项计划贯彻了总统李在明上周内阁会议的指示，即集中全国政府资源保护民众生命安全，让日常生活更加安全。林在新闻发布会上说：“对于利用民众陷入绝境之机、造成经济损害的案件，我们将追究幕后的责任人，即使他们身处海外，也要从源头瓦解其犯罪网络并阻断犯罪收益。”根据现行法律，被判无期徒刑的囚犯服刑20年后可获考虑假释。2023年，内阁批准了一项修正《刑法》的法案，拟引入不得假释的无期徒刑，作为使罪行极其严重的犯罪者永久与社会隔绝的手段。该提案原本允许法院区分可能假释与不得假释的无期徒刑。法案未能在本届任期于2024年5月届满的第二届国民议会表决前获得通过

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Investors shrug off Huang scandal to buy the dip Korean investors aggressively bought Nvidia shares last week, seizing on a steep sell-off triggered by revelations of former CEO Jensen Huang's extramarital affairs and subsequent resignation as a buying opportunity, data showed Sunday. Nvidia topped Korean investors' net-buying list for U.S.-listed stocks from Nov. 9 through Friday, with the amount reaching $319.75 million, according to SEIBro, a data portal operated by the Korea Securities Depository. The figure represented a 717 percent surge from the previous week. The buying marked a sharp reversal from the start of the week, when Korean investors initially sold a net $6.6 million worth of Nvidia shares on Nov. 9 following Huang's public admission of marital infidelity. But the selling was short-lived. Korean investors resumed buying the following day and stepped up purchases on Friday, snapping up a whopping $254.85 million worth of Nvidia shares as the stock plunged as much as 14 percent intraday on news of Huang's resignation. The buying spree extended to domestically listed exchange-traded funds (ETFs). The five Korea-listed ETFs with the highest weightings in Nvidia drew about 1 billion won ($746,268) in net purchases from retail investors over the same period, according to Korea Exchange data. The buying spree suggests that investors viewed Nvidia's steep decline as a bargain-hunting opportunity, analysts say, even as uncertainty surrounding its leadership weighed on the stock. "While the recent scandal involving Jensen Huang has raised uncertainty, we see limited risk of a direct impact on artificial intelligence (AI) demand or supply contracts," said Lee Kyoung-min, an analyst at Daishin Securities. Lee said Nvidia's earnings report next Tuesday (local time) could be a key turning point for a potential rebound not only in Nvidia shares but also in AI and semiconductor stocks more broadly, provided the company demonstrates strong demand and a clear road map for next-generation graphics processing units. Beyond their appetite for Nvidia shares, some Korean investors have also shown support for Huang himself, despite the controversy surrounding his departure. Huang has long enjoyed a favorable reputation in Korea, thanks in part to his repeated praise for Korean chipmakers and his approachable public persona. His widely publicized gathering over fried chicken and beer with Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-young and Hyundai Motor Group Executive Chair Chung Euisun further charmed the Korean public. Some Koreans have also signed an online petition titled "Stand With Jensen," calling for Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO. The petition had garnered about 126,500 signatures as of noon Sunday. Kim Kyeong-pyo, who identified himself as an Nvidia shareholder, described Huang as a visionary leader and expressed confidence in his leadership. "I strongly believe that Nvidia's continued success depends on Jensen Huang's leadership. I sincerely hope he will continue to lead the company and guide Nvidia toward even greater achievements," Kim wrote
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 英伟达居韩国投资者每周美国股票买入榜首位
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 投资者淡化黄仁勋丑闻，逢低买入Nvidia股份。数据显示，韩国投资者上周大举买入Nvidia股份，把前首席执行官Jensen Huang婚外情曝光及随后辞职引发的股价暴跌视为买入机会。韩国证券存管机构运营的数据门户SEIBro数据显示，从11月9日至周五，Nvidia位居韩国投资者净买入美国上市股票的榜首，净买入金额达到3.1975亿美元，较前一周激增717%。这一买入规模与本周初相比出现显著逆转。Huang公开承认婚姻不忠后，韩国投资者于11月9日最初净卖出价值660万美元的Nvidia股份。但抛售并未持续。韩国投资者于次日恢复买入，并在周五加大购买力度，在Huang辞职消息推动股价盘中一度暴跌14%之际，抄底买入价值高达2.5485亿美元的Nvidia股份。这轮购买热潮还延伸至韩国境内上市的交易型开放式指数基金（ETF）。韩国交易所数据显示，在同一时期内，Nvidia持仓权重最高的5只韩国上市ETF获得散户约10亿韩元（746,268美元）的净买入。分析师表示，这轮购买热潮表明，尽管公司领导层的不确定性压制股价，投资者仍将Nvidia股价的大幅下跌视为低价买入的机会。大信证券分析师Lee Kyoung-min表示：“尽管近期涉及Jensen Huang的丑闻加大了不确定性，但我们认为，人工智能（AI）需求或供应合同受到直接冲击的风险有限。”Lee表示，如果Nvidia展现出强劲需求和清晰的下一代图形处理单元发展路线图，其下周二（当地时间）发布的财报可能成为Nvidia股份乃至更广泛AI和半导体股潜在反弹的关键转折点。除热衷于购买Nvidia股份外，一些韩国投资者也支持Huang本人，尽管他离职引发了争议。Huang长期以来在韩国享有良好声誉，部分原因是他经常称赞韩国芯片制造商，而且其平易近人的公众形象广受认可。他与Samsung Electronics董事长Lee Jae-young及Hyundai Motor Group执行董事长Chung Euisun一起吃炸鸡、喝啤酒的聚会广为传播，也进一步赢得了韩国公众的喜爱。一些韩国人还在网上签署了一份题为“Stand With Jensen”的请愿书，要求Huang恢复Nvidia首席执行官职务。截至周日中午，请愿书已获得约126,500个签名。自称Nvidia股东的Kim Kyeong-pyo称Huang是一位具有远见的领导者，并对其领导能力表示信心。Kim写道：“我坚信，Nvidia持续取得成功有赖于Jensen Huang的领导。我衷心希望他能继续领导公司，带领Nvidia迈向更加辉煌的成就。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: On Friday, Reps. Choi Min-hee, Han Min-soo and Lee Seong-yun, all Supreme Council members and considered loyalists to Jung, boycotted a meeting in protest against Kim’s order the previous day for the party's ethics committee to investigate Choi. They instead held a press conference to call for the party's reform, criticizing Kim's leadership. Kim and Jung competed in a bitterly contested party leadership race in August. Kim ordered the investigation — a primary step for a disciplinary action — after the release of a recording in which Choi told party members last month that President Lee Jae Myung had opposed former President Yoon Suk Yeol’s impeachment. Choi’s claim contradicted Lee’s public support for removing Yoon over his botched martial law declaration in December 2024, prompting Cheong Wa Dae to dismiss Choi’s account as groundless. Choi later said she may have confused the issue with the impeachment of Yoon’s former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo. Her allies then launched a counterattacked against Kim, with Han saying, "Kim ordered the investigation to a colleague, as if he had been waiting for her mistake, without first seeking an explanation ... It is Kim who should be under the ethics committee's investigation." But Rep. Park Sun-won, another Supreme Council member and a supporter of Kim, urged Choi to apologize, saying, "People should apologize when they have to. If not, it is a divisive act." The boycott has further strained relations between the rival camps after Kim accused Jung’s supporters of forming a secret alliance with the religious sect Shincheonji. Kim apologized on Nov. 3 after acknowledging a lack of evidence, but Jung’s supporters have continued demanding political accountability. Jung rejected Kim’s offer of talks, Thursday, arguing that the damage to party members and supporters could not be resolved through a private meeting between the two politicians. Kim also faces criticism for failing to set a clear course on impeaching Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, whom ruling bloc lawmakers accuse of political bias over the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn the president's acquittal in an election law case ahead of the 2025 presidential election. The DPK remains divided over whether to pursue immediate impeachment, or first conduct a parliamentary investigation, with the Jung faction seeking impeachment. Lee Seong-yun accused Kim of wavering between the two options without following through on either. "Kim was indecisive over whether to impeach Cho or not, but suddenly came up with the parliamentary investigation option. But he is again putting off the decision on whether to pursue the option," he said. Property tax reform has exposed another friction within the party. The Lee administration plans to raise the threshold for the comprehensive real estate tax, a punitive levy aimed at curbing housing speculation amid a housing shortage, from 1.2 billion won to 1.4 billion won ($1.04 million) for single-home owners who live in their property. Some DPK lawmakers representing greater Seoul want the same tax relief extended to those who live elsewhere for work or other reasons, while Kim backs the government’s proposal

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title: Why Anthropic's blockbuster IPO is getting a muted reception in Korea
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.summary: SpaceX's ETF hangover dampens industry enthusiasm Anthropic's planned initial public offering (IPO) is drawing a muted response in Korea despite expectations it could raise a record-high $90.4 billion, as local brokerages and asset managers shy away from the deal following fallout from SpaceX's IPO, industry officials said Sunday. There were no Korean brokerages among the 22 underwriters named in Anthropic's S-1 registration statement filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.summary_zh: SpaceX的ETF上市后遗问题抑制了行业热情。行业人士周日表示，尽管外界预计Anthropic计划进行的首次公开募股（IPO）可能筹得创纪录的$90.4 billion，但受SpaceX的IPO余波影响，韩国本地经纪商和资产管理机构均对这笔交易持观望态度，Anthropic的IPO在韩国反应冷淡。Anthropic向美国证券交易委员会提交的S-1注册声明列出了22家承销商，其中没有一家韩国经纪商。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body: SpaceX's ETF hangover dampens industry enthusiasm Anthropic's planned initial public offering (IPO) is drawing a muted response in Korea despite expectations it could raise a record-high $90.4 billion, as local brokerages and asset managers shy away from the deal following fallout from SpaceX's IPO, industry officials said Sunday. There were no Korean brokerages among the 22 underwriters named in Anthropic's S-1 registration statement filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. Korean retail investors are therefore unlikely to gain access to shares through the IPO. Those in Korea will still be able to invest through exchange-traded funds (ETFs). Major asset managers, including Mirae Asset, KB, NH-Amundi and Samsung Asset Management, have launched a range of related ETFs since news of Anthropic's IPO plan emerged. The funds have provisions allowing index committees to consider adding AI companies such as Anthropic once they go public in the U.S. Still, asset managers are taking a cautious approach to launching and promoting the products, emphasizing broader investment themes such as U.S. technology, large language models and agentic AI rather than Anthropic itself. The caution stems from the fallout that followed Mirae Asset Securities' failure to secure shares in SpaceX's May IPO as underwriter. The brokerage sought to give Korean investors access to the offering by joining the U.S. underwriting syndicate but ultimately received no allocation. The Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) later conducted an on-site inspection, prompting Mirae Asset Securities to pledge full compensation for affected clients. Asset managers also came under scrutiny after aggressively marketing ETFs on the prospect of gaining direct exposure to SpaceX's IPO shares. Mirae Asset's failure to secure an allocation left those expectations unmet, drawing regulatory attention. The regulatory scrutiny has since extended to preparations for Anthropic's IPO. On Oct. 30, the FSS met with asset managers and brokerages to review their investment plans and product preparations, urging restraint in marketing. Concerns over stretched AI valuations are adding to the caution. Space-themed ETFs with exposure to SpaceX have suffered steep losses, with some funds that bought shares during the post-IPO frenzy down more than 50 percent
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title_zh: 为何 Anthropic 备受瞩目的首次公开募股在韩国反应冷淡
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body_zh: SpaceX上市后遗留的阴霾打击行业热情。行业官员周日表示，Anthropic计划进行首次公开募股（IPO），尽管外界预计此次募股规模可能创下904亿美元的历史纪录，但韩国市场反应冷淡。Anthropic向美国证券交易委员会提交的S-1注册声明中列出了22家承销商，其中没有一家韩国券商。因此，韩国散户不太可能通过此次IPO获得股票认购机会。韩国投资者仍可通过交易所交易基金（ETF）进行投资。自Anthropic公布IPO计划以来，Mirae Asset、KB、NH-Amundi和Samsung Asset Management等大型资产管理公司已推出多只相关ETF。这些基金设有相关条款，允许指数委员会在Anthropic等人工智能公司赴美上市后考虑将其纳入指数。不过，资产管理公司在推出和推广这些产品时仍持谨慎态度，重点强调美国科技、大语言模型和智能体人工智能等更广泛的投资主题，而非Anthropic本身。这种谨慎态度源于Mirae Asset Securities作为承销商参与SpaceX 5月IPO却未能获得配售所引发的后续影响。该券商曾加入美国承销银团，试图让韩国投资者参与此次发行，但最终未获得任何配额。韩国金融监督服务院（FSS）随后进行现场检查，促使Mirae Asset Securities承诺对受影响客户予以全额赔偿。在积极宣传有望直接投资SpaceX IPO股票的ETF之后，资产管理公司也受到审查。Mirae Asset未能获得配额，导致投资者的相关预期落空，并引起监管关注。此后，监管审查范围又延伸至Anthropic IPO的筹备工作。10月30日，FSS与资产管理公司和券商会面，审查其投资计划和产品筹备情况，并敦促其在营销中保持克制。对人工智能估值过高的担忧进一步加剧了这种谨慎情绪。持有SpaceX股份的太空主题ETF已遭受大幅亏损，其中一些在上市后狂热期间买入相关股票的基金跌幅超过50%

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The squid catch around Ulleung Island has plummeted amid rising sea temperatures caused by climate change, highlighting how warming waters are reshaping Korea’s marine ecosystem and the coastal communities that depend on it. According to Ulleung County on Sunday, the local catch fell from 11,315 tons in 2000 to 1,852 tons in 2015 and 1,172 tons in 2020, before plunging to 141 tons in 2025. The 2025 catch amounted to just 1.2 percent of the 2000 figure. The decline has continued this year, with only 54 tons caught from January to September. Squid is the signature seafood of the island in North Gyeongsang Province and has long been a mainstay of its economy. The decline stems largely from rising sea temperatures, which have reshuffled the marine food chain and are pushing squid out of Korean waters. The National Institute of Fisheries Science (NIFS) believes squid that would normally grow off Korea’s coast have moved north toward Russia and other areas as their main coastal and offshore habitat in the southern East Sea has warmed. The average sea surface temperature around the Korean Peninsula from January to June this year was 17.17 degrees Celsius, the highest level in 26 years. That marks an increase of 1.17 degrees from last year and 0.52 degrees from the previous record set in 2020, according to NIFS. Along the east coast, the average sea surface temperature from April to June this year rose 1.9 degrees from last year to 16.3 degrees Celsius. The sharp drop in Ulleung’s squid catch has fueled calls for the island to farm new high-value species to replace squid. Last month, the county began farming goldeye rockfish as a potential alternative, though only as a pilot project. It has also tried farming shrimp, red sea cucumber and Korean rockfish, among others, but none has yet become established enough to fill the gap. “Finding new sources of income is important as local fisheries struggle with climate change and a shrinking squid catch,” Ulleung County Mayor Nam Han-kwon said. The sharp decline in squid catch on the island is the latest example of how rising water temperatures are transforming Korea’s seas. Shark sightings off Korea's east coast have nearly quadrupled this year as climate change pushes more of the predators into Korean waters. According to NIFS, 46 large sharks were spotted off the east coast from January to June this year, compared with 12 in the same period last year. Shortfin mako sharks, rated "high" for the risk of attack in the agency's shark classification guide, were the most common, with 23 sightings. The surge in shark sightings tracks a broader warming trend in Korean waters. As temperatures climb, warm-water fish move further north along the east coast, and the large sharks that prey on them follow
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 海洋变暖导致郁陵岛鱿鱼捕捞量25年来下降99%
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 在气候变化导致海水温度上升的背景下，郁陵岛周边鱿鱼捕捞量骤降，凸显了水温升高正在重塑韩国海洋生态系统及依赖海洋资源的沿海社区。郁陵县周日表示，当地鱿鱼捕捞量从2000年的11,315吨降至2015年的1,852吨和2020年的1,172吨，随后在2025年暴跌至141吨。2025年的捕捞量仅相当于2000年的1.2%。今年捕捞量仍在下降，1月至9月仅捕捞54吨。鱿鱼是位于庆尚北道这座岛屿的代表性海产品，长期以来一直是当地经济的重要支柱。捕捞量下降主要源于海水温度上升。升温和海洋食物链重组正把鱿鱼驱离韩国近海。韩国国立渔业科学研究院（NIFS）认为，随着东海南部沿海及外海主要栖息地水温升高，通常生长在韩国近海的鱿鱼已向北迁移至俄罗斯及其他地区。据NIFS称，今年1月至6月韩国半岛周边平均海表温度为17.17摄氏度，达到26年来的最高水平，较去年上升1.17摄氏度，较2020年创下的此前纪录高0.52摄氏度。今年4月至6月，韩国东海岸平均海表温度较去年上升1.9摄氏度，达到16.3摄氏度。郁陵岛鱿鱼捕捞量大幅下降，引发要求该岛养殖新高价值物种以替代鱿鱼的呼声。上个月，该县启动了金眼岩鲈养殖项目，将其作为潜在替代品种，但目前仅为试点项目。当地还尝试养殖虾、红海参和韩国岩鲈等品种，但尚未任何一个形成足够规模，无法弥补鱿鱼捕捞减少造成的缺口。郁陵县县长南汉权表示：“在气候变化和鱿鱼捕捞量萎缩导致当地渔业陷入困境之际，寻找新的收入来源十分重要。”岛上鱿鱼捕捞量急剧下降，是水温上升正在改变韩国海洋的最新例证。随着气候变化把更多捕食者驱入韩国近海，今年韩国东海岸目击鲨鱼的次数几乎增至去年的4倍。据NIFS称，今年1月至6月东海岸共目击46条大型鲨鱼，而去年同期为12条。其中，短鳍灰鲭鲨最为常见，共目击23次；该机构制定的鲨鱼风险分类指南将这种鲨鱼的袭击风险列为“高”。鲨鱼目击次数激增与韩国近海整体升温趋势一致。随着水温攀升，暖水鱼类沿东海岸进一步北迁，捕食这些鱼类的大型鲨鱼也随之而来……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title: Experience-first hiring leaves more young Koreans in irregular jobs
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: “So even when positions were technically open to candidates with and without experience, I felt I never really stood a chance competing against people who had already spent years in the workforce.” For nearly two years, the 27-year-old relied on part-time teaching jobs to make ends meet. Her experience reflects a broader struggle among young job seekers in the country, where nearly half of young wage earners now work in irregular positions.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: “所以，即使有些职位在技术层面上对有无经验的候选人都开放，我也觉得自己根本无意与已经在职场工作多年的人竞争。”近两年来，这名27岁女子依靠兼职教师工作维持生计。她的经历反映了这个国家年轻求职者面临的更广泛困境：如今，近一半的年轻工资收入者从事的是非正规岗位。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: For Son Ga-hyun, who managed to land a job in textbook development after years of searching, job hunting in Korea had been a slow grind with little to show for it. “Entry-level openings were few and far between, and even internships would be packed with applicants with substantial work experience,” she said. “So even when positions were technically open to candidates with and without experience, I felt I never really stood a chance competing against people who had already spent years in the workforce.” For nearly two years, the 27-year-old relied on part-time teaching jobs to make ends meet. Her experience reflects a broader struggle among young job seekers in the country, where nearly half of young wage earners now work in irregular positions. As of Aug. 31, irregular workers accounted for 46 percent of wage earners aged 15 to 29 — the highest ratio recorded by the Ministry of Data and Statistics since it began compiling the data in 2003. The figure was considerably higher than the 38.5 percent recorded among wage earners of all ages. The trend points to a changing hiring culture that is making it more difficult for young people to secure stable jobs. In a cooling economy, an increasing number of companies are gravitating toward candidates who can step into a role with little training over those they would need to develop from the ground up. A 2026 survey of 500 companies with at least 100 employees, conducted by the Korea Enterprises Federation, found that 67.6 percent of respondents ranked relevant work experience as the most important of seven criteria they considered when hiring new recruits. “So what companies really want these days are ‘pre-experienced rookies,’” Son said. “It’s a system where you can’t build experience because no one gives you the chance in the first place.” Hong Sok-chul, an economics professor at Seoul National University, said the preference for experienced hires reflects both employers’ business needs and changes in the labor market. “From an employer’s perspective, experienced workers are simply more productive. That preference has always existed,” he said. “What’s changed is the applicant pool. People no longer expect to spend their entire careers at one company. They move between jobs to advance their careers, and as a result, the pool of applicants itself has become more experienced. Companies are responding to that.” The pressure on young job seekers is also reflected in the broader employment figures. While Korea added 139,000 jobs overall last month, the number of employed people aged 15 to 29 fell by 196,000 from a year earlier, marking the 48th consecutive month of decline. “Youth employment has continued to decline partly because companies are moving away from large-scale open recruitment toward rolling, position-specific hiring,” said Bin Hyun-joon, director general of social statistics at the Ministry of Data and Statistics
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 以经验优先的招聘模式使更多韩国年轻人从事非正规工作
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 对于孙佳贤而言，在多年求职后终于找到一份教材开发工作之前，在韩国求职一直进展缓慢，几乎看不到成果。她说：“入门级职位少之又少，就连实习岗位也会挤满拥有丰富工作经验的应聘者。”“所以，即便有些职位在名义上同时接受有经验和无经验的应聘者，我也始终觉得自己根本没法和那些已经在职场工作多年的人竞争。”近两年来，这名27岁的年轻人靠从事兼职教学工作维持生计。她的经历反映出韩国年轻求职者面临的更广泛困境：如今，该国近一半的年轻劳动 earners从事的是非正规岗位。截至8月31日，15至29岁劳动 earners中，非正规劳动者占46%，这是数据统计部自2003年开始编制相关数据以来记录到的最高比例。这一数字明显高于所有年龄劳动 earners中非正规劳动者所占的38.5%。这一趋势表明，招聘文化正在发生改变，使年轻人更难获得稳定工作。在经济降温之际，越来越多公司倾向于选择几乎无需培训即可上岗的候选人，而不是需要从头培养的新人。韩国企业联合会开展的一项2026年调查覆盖了500家员工不少于100人的企业，结果显示，67.6%的受访企业将相关工作经验列为招聘新员工时考虑的七项标准中最重要的一项。孙说：“所以，这些企业如今真正想要的是‘有经验的新手’。”“这是一套让人无法积累经验的制度，因为从一开始就没有人给你机会。”首尔大学经济学教授洪 석哲（Hong Sok-chul）表示，偏好有经验的应聘者，既反映了雇主的经营需要，也反映了劳动力市场的变化。他说：“从雇主角度看，有经验的劳动者就是生产力更高。这种偏好一直存在。”“发生变化的是应聘者群体。人们不再指望在一家公司度过整个职业生涯。他们通过跳槽来推进职业发展，因此应聘者群体本身也更有经验了。企业正在对此作出回应。”年轻求职者承受的压力也反映在更广泛的就业数据中。尽管韩国上月总体增加了139,000个就业岗位，但15至29岁就业人数同比减少196,000，连续第48个月下降。数据统计部社会统计总局长卞贤俊说：“青年就业人数持续下降，部分原因是企业正从大规模公开招聘转向滚动式、按具体岗位进行的招聘。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title: Gov't says Nvidia's Korea pledges remain intact despite Jensen Huang's exit
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: Uncertainties linger amid remarks suggesting Huang's personal role in securing partnerships The Korean government said Nvidia's existing partnership commitments to Korea remain intact despite disgraced CEO Jensen Huang's departure from the artificial intelligence (AI) giant.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 有关黄仁勋在促成合作方面所发挥个人作用的言论引发诸多不确定因素。韩国政府表示，尽管声名受损的首席执行官黄仁勋已离开这家人工智能巨头，但 Nvidia 对韩国现有的合作承诺仍然不变。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: Uncertainties linger amid remarks suggesting Huang's personal role in securing partnerships The Korean government said Nvidia's existing partnership commitments to Korea remain intact despite disgraced CEO Jensen Huang's departure from the artificial intelligence (AI) giant. However, uncertainties linger as remarks by Elon Musk and others suggest that much of the cooperation may have relied on Huang's personal verbal commitments. The Ministry of Science and ICT said it held a meeting with Nvidia officials Friday, a day after Huang resigned as the company's CEO, and confirmed that plans to supply graphics processing units (GPUs) to Korea and other collaborative projects remain on track. “The second vice minister presided over a meeting with Nvidia and reconfirmed that the company plans to proceed with the supply of 260,000 GPUs and cooperation with Korean companies as previously announced,” Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Science and ICT Bae Kyung-hoon wrote on Facebook Friday. During Huang’s visit to Korea in October last year, Nvidia promised to supply a total of 260,000 GPUs, with Samsung Electronics, SK Group, Hyundai Motor Group and the government each securing 50,000. Naver Cloud agreed to receive the remaining 60,000. According to Bae, the plan is proceeding as scheduled. Of the 50,000 GPUs allocated to the government, 35,000 will be procured directly, while the remaining 15,000 will be secured through the National AI Computing Center. Bae said the government has already secured computing capacity equivalent to approximately 21,000 Nvidia B200 GPUs, with the remainder expected to arrive by early 2027. Naver's partnership with Nvidia is also resulting in tangible outcomes. Nvidia has pledged to invest in Naver as part of their joint AI data center business and paid 1.34 trillion won ($1 billion) through Naver's capital increase on Nov. 6 to acquire a 4.13 percent stake in the Korean mobile platform company. Despite signs that Nvidia’s existing commitments to Korea are insulated from the fallout of Huang’s disgraceful departure, industry observers still see uncertainties, as Huang reportedly relied heavily on verbal agreements rather than formal contracts in conducting business. Musk also shared a response from Grok citing Huang's podcast interviews in March and April. In the interview, the former Nvidia chief said the company had no formal legal contract with TSMC despite conducting hundreds of billions of dollars in business over the past 30 years. Huang described the relationship as one governed by a form of “rough justice,” with the two companies placing complete trust in each other. Musk wrote that Huang always kept his promises, adding, “We’d put together a purchase order at some point later, but I never for a second thought it wouldn’t happen.” His remarks suggest that trust in Huang personally played a key role in securing business deals. “Whether formal contracts exist in Huang's absence would vary from deal to deal, but commitments made verbally may need to be reviewed to ensure they can result in actual deliveries,” an industry official said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 政府表示，尽管 Jensen Huang 离任，Nvidia 对韩国的承诺仍将维持
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 有关黄仁勋个人在促成合作方面所发挥作用的言论引发种种不确定性。韩国政府表示，尽管声名狼藉的首席执行官黄仁勋已离开人工智能巨头Nvidia，但Nvidia现有的对韩合作承诺仍保持不变。然而，Elon Musk等人的言论暗示，这项合作很大程度上可能依赖黄仁勋个人作出的口头承诺，因此种种不确定性仍然存在。韩国科学技术信息通信部表示，该部于黄仁勋辞去Nvidia首席执行官职务的次日星期五与Nvidia官员会面，并确认向韩国供应图形处理单元（GPU）及其他合作项目的计划仍在推进。副总理兼科学技术信息通信部长裴庆勋星期五在Facebook上写道：“第二次世界大战时期的副部长与Nvidia会面，并再次确认该公司计划按此前公布的内容，向韩国供应26万块GPU，并与韩国企业开展合作。”去年10月黄仁勋访问韩国期间，Nvidia承诺总共供应26万块GPU，Samsung Electronics、SK Group、Hyundai Motor Group和韩国政府各获得5万块。Naver Cloud同意接收其余6万块。据裴庆勋介绍，该计划正按原定日程推进。在分配给政府的5万块GPU中，3.5万块将由政府直接采购，其余1.5万块将通过国家人工智能计算中心获得。裴庆勋表示，政府已经获得相当于约2.1万块Nvidia B200 GPU的计算能力，其余设备预计将于2027年初运抵。Naver与Nvidia的合作也取得了实际成果。Nvidia承诺作为双方联合人工智能数据中心业务的一部分投资Naver，并于11月6日通过Naver增资支付1.34万亿韩元（10亿美元），取得这家韩国移动平台公司4.13%的股份。尽管有迹象表明，Nvidia现有的对韩承诺不受黄仁勋不光彩离职所引发的影响，但业界观察人士仍认为存在不确定性，因为据报道，黄仁勋在开展业务时很大程度上依赖口头协议，而非正式合同。Musk还分享了Grok的一段回应，其中引用了黄仁勋在3月和4月播客采访中的说法。在那次采访中，这位Nvidia前掌门人表示，尽管过去30年来双方开展了数千亿美元的业务往来，但公司与TSMC之间没有正式法律合同。黄仁勋将双方关系描述为一种由“粗犷的正义”支配的关系，两家公司完全信任彼此。Musk写道，黄仁勋始终信守承诺，并补充说：“我们总会在之后某个时候拟定采购订单，但我从未有一秒钟怀疑过订单不会得到执行。”他的言论表明，个人层面的信任在促成商业交易方面发挥了关键作用。一名业界官员表示：“黄仁勋不在场时是否有正式合同，要视具体交易而定，但口头作出的承诺可能需要重新审查，以确保这些承诺能够转化为实际交付。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title: Specter of another Yalta overstated
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary: The specter of the Yalta Conference is haunting Korea as the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit approaches. During a recent meeting with a Chinese official, a high-ranking South Korean official reportedly expressed concern that an upcoming trilateral summit among the U.S., China and Russia, to be held on the sidelines of the APEC summit, should not turn into another Yalta Conference.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary_zh: 随着亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会临近，雅尔塔会议的阴影笼罩着韩国。据报道，韩国一名高级官员在近期会见中国官员时表示，他担心即将在美国、中国和俄罗斯举行的三方峰会不要演变成又一场雅尔塔会议。该三方峰会将在APEC峰会期间举行。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: The specter of the Yalta Conference is haunting Korea as the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit approaches. Such concerns reflect either a victim mentality or diplomatic overstatement. During a recent meeting with a Chinese official, a high-ranking South Korean official reportedly expressed concern that an upcoming trilateral summit among the U.S., China and Russia, to be held on the sidelines of the APEC summit, should not turn into another Yalta Conference. The original Yalta talks were held in 1945 among the so-called Big Three world powers: the U.S., the United Kingdom and the Soviet Union. At the time, the three powers agreed that Korea, then under Japanese colonial rule, would be placed under a multilateral trusteeship before gaining full independence from Japan. In the years that followed, Korea was divided into two, with the South placed under U.S. military administration and the North under Soviet military administration. Korea had no voice in the process, and its fate was determined by the major powers of the time. On Saturday, the foreign ministry official told reporters that he had raised concerns about the potential consequences of the U.S.-China-Russia summit for South Korea during separate meetings with his American and Chinese counterparts. "I explicitly told my Chinese counterpart that the U.S.-China-Russia summit should not become another Yalta Conference," he said, speaking on condition of anonymity. Although he did not elaborate on what prompted his concern, he appeared to be worried about the possibility of the three countries reaching a consensus or agreement on North Korea, particularly regarding its nuclear status. As a diplomat, he was arguably doing his job by bringing up a potential threat to South Korea's vital national interests. In this case, his purpose appears to be preventing North Korea from gaining international recognition as a nuclear weapon state. In that sense, his warning is legitimate. Whether his judgment was appropriate, however, is another matter. His fear of a repeat of Korea's tragic history appears exaggerated, if not unrealistic. Experts believe symbolism, rather than substance, will dominate the trilateral summit, with little chance of a treaty or formal agreement emerging from the meeting. The U.S., China and Russia have different strategic calculations and expectations. According to the White House, U.S. President Donald Trump will prioritize reducing nuclear weapons and preventing their proliferation. China, meanwhile, sees the summit as an opportunity to showcase its diplomatic influence as the host country. Russia is arguably the biggest beneficiary of the meeting, as it will reinforce Moscow's status as a major global power on par with Washington and Beijing, despite its ongoing invasion of Ukraine and the international sanctions imposed in response. How could three countries with such different priorities and expectations possibly reach a substantive agreement? It also remains unclear whether abandoning denuclearization as the ultimate goal for North Korea would serve the vital interests of China and Russia. Both countries share borders with North Korea. Would either feel comfortable with a neighboring state possessing a nuclear arsenal? There is another, more serious problem revealed by the foreign ministry official's remarks about North Korea's nuclear weapons. He made clear that arms reduction talks with North Korea would hurt South Korea because they could effectively allow Pyongyang to retain its existing nuclear arsenal. The diplomat's position stands in stark contrast to that of President Lee Jae Myung. Lee has repeatedly pointed out that North Korea already possesses dozens of nuclear weapons and that its arsenal will continue to grow unless effective measures are taken. He has suggested arms reduction talks as a realistic way to freeze North Korea's nuclear program and prevent further expansion of its arsenal. The apparent divergence between Lee and the senior foreign ministry official raises a fundamental question: What exactly is South Korea's official position? Inconsistent messaging on a critical issue such as North Korea's nuclear program risks confusing South Korea's ally and partners, undermining efforts to build a coordinated international response. South Korea is no longer the country it was in 1945. Back then, Korea was a colony without sovereignty and had no means of making its voice heard, even on decisions that would ultimately determine its fate. Today, South Korea is one of the world's most dynamic economies and an influential member of the international community. It has both the standing and the means to make its voice heard. South Korea's future will be determined by the choices it makes today, not by agreements or treaties struck by other countries behind its back. To ensure that, Seoul must send a clear and consistent message to the international community on key issues, particularly North Korea's nuclear program
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title_zh: 重演雅尔塔的阴影被夸大了
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh: 随着亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会临近，雅尔塔会议的阴影正在笼罩韩国。此类担忧要么反映受害者心态，要么属于对外交风险的夸大。近日与一名中国官员会面时，据报道，一名韩国高官表示关切，称即将在美国、中国和俄罗斯举行的三方峰会——该会议将在APEC峰会期间举行——不应演变为又一场雅尔塔会议。最初的雅尔塔会议于1945年召开，参与者是所谓的世界“三巨头”：美国、英国和苏联。当时，三方商定，尚处于日本殖民统治下的朝鲜将在获得完全独立之前置于多国托管之下。此后数年，朝鲜一分为二，南部由美国军事 administration 管辖，北部由苏联军事 administration 管辖。朝鲜在这一过程中没有发言权，其命运由当时的大国决定。周六，这名外交部官员对记者表示，他在分别会见美国和中国对口官员时，提出了美中俄峰会可能给韩国带来的后果等关切。他说：“我明确告诉我的中国对口官员，美中俄峰会不应成为又一场雅尔塔会议。”他在匿名条件下 speaking 时表示，尽管没有详细说明促使他产生担忧的原因，但他似乎担心三国可能就朝鲜问题达成共识或协议，尤其是涉及朝鲜核地位的问题。作为外交官，他提出朝鲜对韩国重大国家利益构成的潜在威胁，可以说是在履行职责。就此而言，他的目的是防止朝鲜获得核武器国家的国际承认。从这个意义上说，他的警告是合理的。然而，他的判断是否恰当，则是另一回事。他对朝鲜悲剧历史重演的恐惧显得夸大，甚至不切实际。专家认为，此次三方峰会将主要由象征意义而非实质成果主导，几乎不可能产生条约或正式协议。美国、中国和俄罗斯在战略考量与预期方面各不相同。据白宫称，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将优先推动削减核武器并防止核武器扩散。中国则把此次峰会视为展示其作为东道国 diplomatic influence 的机会。俄罗斯可以说才是此次会议最大的受益者，因为尽管其仍在入侵乌克兰并因此受到国际制裁，会议仍有助于强化莫斯科作为与华盛顿和北京并列的全球主要大国地位。三个优先事项和预期如此不同的国家，怎么可能达成实质性协议？同样不清楚的是，放弃推动朝鲜无核化这一终极目标，是否符合中国和俄罗斯的重大利益。两国都与朝鲜接壤。任何一个国家能安心接受邻国拥有核武库吗？这名外交部官员有关朝鲜核武器的言论还揭示出另一个更为严重的问题。他明确表示，与朝鲜开展削减武器谈判将损害韩国，因为这种谈判实际上可能让平壤保留现有核武库。这名外交官的立场与李在明总统的立场形成鲜明对比。李在明反复指出，朝鲜已经拥有数十枚核武器，除非采取有效措施，其核武库还将继续增长。他曾提出，削减武器谈判是冻结朝鲜核计划、阻止其核武库进一步扩张的现实途径。李在明与外交部高级官员之间明显的立场分歧提出了一个根本问题：韩国的官方立场究竟是什么？在朝鲜核计划这一关键问题上传递前后矛盾的信息，可能使韩国的盟友和伙伴感到困惑，削弱各方建立协调一致国际回应的努力。韩国已不再是1945年的那个国家。当时，朝鲜是没有主权的殖民地，即使是对最终决定其命运的决定，也无法发出自己的声音。如今，韩国是世界上最具活力的经济体之一，也是国际社会中有影响力的成员。它既有地位，也有能力让自己的声音被听见。韩国的未来将由其今天所作的选择决定，而不是由其他国家在背后达成的协议或条约决定。为此，首尔必须在关键问题上向国际社会传递清晰且一致的信息，尤其是朝鲜核计划问题

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title: ICT exports log record-high growth in Oct. amid AI boom
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: South Korea's exports of information and communication technology (ICT) products rose at the sharpest pace on record from a year earlier in October, data showed Sunday, driven by the global artificial intelligence (AI) boom. The figure also marked the second-highest monthly total on record, just below the $75.1 billion posted in September.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 数据显示，受全球人工智能（AI）热潮推动，韩国10月信息通信技术（ICT）产品出口额较上年同期创下有记录以来最快增速。这一数字也创下有记录以来第二高的单月总额，仅略低于9月的751亿美元。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: South Korea's exports of information and communication technology (ICT) products rose at the sharpest pace on record from a year earlier in October, data showed Sunday, driven by the global artificial intelligence (AI) boom. Outbound shipments of ICT products came to $70.35 billion in October, more than tripling from $23.29 billion a year earlier, according to data compiled by the Ministry of Science and ICT. The figure also marked the second-highest monthly total on record, just below the $75.1 billion posted in September. The report also showed ICT exports accounted for 61 percent of the country's total outbound shipments of $115.28 billion in October, with the proportion remaining above 60 percent for three consecutive months. Exports of semiconductors shot up 259.4 percent on-year in October to $56.47 billion, driven by strong global demand for premium memory products and persistently high memory prices. Outbound shipments of computers and accessories also reached $5.99 billion in October, growing more than fivefold from a year earlier, led by high-capacity solid-state drives (SSDs) for servers. Exports of mobile phones rose 6.5 percent to $1.71 billion on the back of strong sales of premium models. By destination, exports to China more than tripled to $27.2 billion, driven by gains in semiconductors and computers. Shipments to the United States also grew more than sixfold to $15.56 billion, the report showed
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 在人工智能热潮推动下，信息和通信技术出口10月创下历史最高增幅
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国信息与通信技术（ICT）产品出口额10月同比创下有记录以来最大增幅，数据周日显示，这主要受全球人工智能（AI）热潮推动。韩国科学技术与信息通信部汇总的数据显示，10月ICT产品出口额达到703.5亿美元，较去年同期的232.9亿美元增长至逾三倍。该数字同时创下有记录以来第二高的单月出口额，仅略低于9月的751亿美元。报告还显示，10月ICT产品占该国出口总额1152.8亿美元的61%，这一比例连续三个月保持在60%以上。10月半导体出口额同比增长259.4%，达到564.7亿美元，主要得益于全球对高端存储产品的强劲需求以及存储产品价格持续高企。10月计算机及配件出口额也达到59.9亿美元，较去年同期增长逾五倍，其中服务器用大容量固态硬盘（SSD）出口额领先。受益于高端机型销量强劲，手机出口额增长6.5%，达到17.1亿美元。按目的地划分，受半导体和计算机出口增长推动，对华出口额增长至逾三倍，达到272亿美元。报告还显示，对美出口额增长至逾六倍，达到155.6亿美元

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.title: HD Hyundai launches autonomous vessel developed with Anduril
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.summary: South Korean shipbuilder HD Hyundai said Sunday it has launched an autonomous surface vessel (ASV) jointly developed with U.S. defense firm Anduril Industries as it seeks to expand into the U.S. market for unmanned naval vessels. HD Hyundai and Anduril held a launching ceremony at HD Hyundai Heavy Industries' shipyard in Ulsan, about 310 kilometers southeast of Seoul, on Thursday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.summary_zh: 韩国造船企业 HD Hyundai 周日表示，该公司已下水一艘自主水面舰艇（ASV）。该舰艇与美国防务企业 Anduril Industries 联合研发，旨在拓展美国无人舰艇市场。周四，HD Hyundai 与 Anduril 在位于釜山以东南约 310 公里的 HD Hyundai Heavy Industries 船厂举行了下水仪式。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body: South Korean shipbuilder HD Hyundai said Sunday it has launched an autonomous surface vessel (ASV) jointly developed with U.S. defense firm Anduril Industries as it seeks to expand into the U.S. market for unmanned naval vessels. HD Hyundai and Anduril held a launching ceremony at HD Hyundai Heavy Industries' shipyard in Ulsan, about 310 kilometers southeast of Seoul, on Thursday. The 600-ton ASV is equipped with VAone, an autonomous navigation solution developed by HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering, and Anduril's Lattice platform, enabling it to conduct reconnaissance, surveillance and maritime intelligence-gathering missions without a crew. HD Hyundai plans to conduct sea trials off Ulsan before further testing in the U.S. early next year to gather operational data as it seeks to enter the U.S. Navy's unmanned vessel market. The U.S. Navy is pursuing a hybrid fleet of manned and unmanned vessels to strengthen its maritime capabilities. In September, it announced plans to procure 30 medium-sized ASVs. The latest launch follows a demonstration by HD Hyundai and Anduril of a 368-ton autonomous test vessel near the Port of Long Beach in California last month
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.title_zh: HD现代推出与Anduril联合开发的自主航行船舶
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body_zh: 韩国造船商HD现代周日表示，随着 seeks 拓展美国无人舰艇市场，该公司与美国防务企业Anduril Industries联合研制的一艘自主水面舰艇（ASV）已经下水。HD现代和Anduril周四在位于首尔东南约310公里的蔚山HD现代重工业船厂举行了下水仪式。这艘600吨重的ASV配备了HD韩国船舶与海洋工程公司开发的自主导航解决方案VAone以及Anduril的Lattice平台，可在无船员的情况下执行侦察、监视和海上情报收集任务。HD现代计划先在蔚山近海进行海试，并于明年初在美国进一步测试，以收集作战数据，争取进入美国海军无人舰艇市场。美国海军正推进有人舰艇与无人舰艇相结合的混合舰队，以增强海上作战能力。9月，美国海军宣布计划采购30艘中型ASV。此次下水是在HD现代和Anduril上月于加利福尼亚州长滩港附近演示一艘368吨重自主测试舰艇之后进行的

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: A North Korean official considered to be one of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's closest aides has arrived in Russia, the North's state media said Sunday, amid deepening relations between the two countries following North Korea's deployment of troops to support Russia's war against Ukraine. Jo Yong-won, secretary of the Central Committee of the ruling Workers' Party, arrived in Moscow by private plane on Saturday, leading a party and government delegation, the Korean Central News Agency said.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 朝鲜国家媒体周日报道称，一名被视为朝鲜领导人 Kim Jong-un 最亲密助手之一的朝鲜官员已经抵达俄罗斯。此前，朝鲜派遣军队支持俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争，两国关系因此日益加深。朝鲜中央通信社称，执政的劳动党中央秘书赵容元（Jo Yong-won）于周六乘私人飞机抵达莫斯科，率领一个党政代表团。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: A North Korean official considered to be one of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's closest aides has arrived in Russia, the North's state media said Sunday, amid deepening relations between the two countries following North Korea's deployment of troops to support Russia's war against Ukraine. Jo Yong-won, secretary of the Central Committee of the ruling Workers' Party, arrived in Moscow by private plane on Saturday, leading a party and government delegation, the Korean Central News Agency said. The visit comes at "a time when the militant friendship, friendship and relations of alliance between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation with independence and justice as their common ideal are being further cemented with each passing day," it said in an English dispatch. The delegation was invited by Dmitry Medvedev, chairman of Russia's ruling United Russia party. They were greeted at the airport by Andrei Klimov, a member of the party's Supreme Council and first vice chairman of the International Affairs Committee of the State Duma, the lower house of Russia's parliament, as well as North Korean Ambassador to Moscow Sin Hong-chol. Speculation that Kim could visit Moscow this year surfaced when North Korea's foreign minister made a surprise visit to Russia in July. Jo's trip comes days before US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are set to meet on the sidelines of an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China, this week
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 朝鲜领导人亲密助手访问俄罗斯，两国双边关系不断加深
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 朝鲜一名被认为是朝鲜领导人金正恩最亲密助手之一的官员已于周日抵达俄罗斯。朝鲜国家媒体称，在朝鲜派兵支持俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争之后，两国关系不断加深。朝鲜劳动党中央 secretary 赵容元（Jo Yong-won）率党政代表团于周六乘私人飞机抵达莫斯科。朝鲜中央通讯社在一份英文电讯中称，此次访问发生在“朝鲜民主主义人民共和国与俄罗斯联邦之间以独立和正义为共同理想的战斗友谊、友谊和联盟关系日益得到巩固之际。”代表团应俄罗斯执政党统一俄罗斯党主席德米特里·梅德韦杰夫邀请。俄罗斯国家下议院——国家杜马国际事务委员会第一副主席、统一俄罗斯党最高委员会成员安德烈·克利莫夫，以及朝鲜驻莫斯科大使辛弘哲在机场迎接了他们。今年7月，朝鲜外相突然访问俄罗斯后，有关金正恩可能于今年访问莫斯科的猜测便已出现。就在赵容元此次访问前数日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京定于本周在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会期间举行会晤。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Kia said Sunday its domestic sales of electrified vehicles surpassed 300,000 units this year as of Monday, making it the first automaker to reach the milestone in Korea in a single year. Kia, an automaking affiliate of Hyundai Motor Group, said its sales of electrified vehicles, including electric vehicles (EVs) and hybrid models, came to 300,048 units, up 41.9 percent from a year earlier. Annual sales of electrified vehicles first topped 100,000 units in 2021, reaching 109,741, before exceeding 200,000 in 2024 at 222,085. Of this year's tally, EVs accounted for 120,360 units, more than doubling from a year earlier and marking the first time an automaker has sold more than 100,000 EVs in Korea in a single year. Sales of hybrid models over the period rose 16.9 percent to 179,688 units. Kia added that its overall domestic sales this year came to 502,286 units, with electrified models accounting for 59.7 percent of the total. Among EVs, the EV3 led sales with 30,455 units, followed by the EV5 with 28,971 and the PV5 with 24,266. Among hybrid models, the Sorento hybrid posted sales of 70,176 units, followed by the Carnival and Sportage hybrid models with 46,056 and 19,264, respectively
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 起亚2026年国内电动化车型销量突破30万辆

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: N. Korea-linked hackers target 30 S. Korean servers: report
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Hackers suspected of having ties to North Korea's Lazarus Group identified 30 servers in South Korea as potential targets for cyberattacks in October, a report released by a cybersecurity firm showed Sunday. Cyfirma said it obtained a list of 216 servers across 10 countries compiled by Korean-speaking hackers, covering government agencies, banks, telecommunications companies and infrastructure providers. Of the total, 30 servers were located in South Korea.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 一家网络安全公司周 日发布的一份报告显示，被怀疑与朝鲜Lazarus Group有关联的黑客在10月锁定了韩国境内的30台服务器，作为网络攻击的潜在目标。Cyfirma表示，它获取了一份由通晓韩语的黑客编制的清单，涉及10个国家的216台服务器，包括政府机构、银行、电信公司以及基础设施提供商。其中30台服务器位于韩国。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Hackers suspected of having ties to North Korea's Lazarus Group identified 30 servers in South Korea as potential targets for cyberattacks in October, a report released by a cybersecurity firm showed Sunday. Cyfirma said it obtained a list of 216 servers across 10 countries compiled by Korean-speaking hackers, covering government agencies, banks, telecommunications companies and infrastructure providers. Of the total, 30 servers were located in South Korea. The original 216-server list was completed on Oct. 24, the report showed. By region, the Asia-Pacific accounted for 148 targeted servers, followed by North America with 49 and the Middle East with 19. The United States and Japan together accounted for 44.4 percent of the total, Cyfirma added. The cybersecurity firm assessed with "high confidence" that the hackers were linked to the Lazarus Group ecosystem, with their apparent objectives including financial gain and espionage. Cyfirma stressed that inclusion on the target list did not necessarily mean the servers had been successfully breached. The company warned that simply updating website applications would not address the vulnerabilities, urging administrators to install security patches and restart the affected programs
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 报告称，与朝鲜有关的黑客瞄准韩国30台服务器
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 一家网络安全公司周日发布的报告显示，疑似与朝鲜 Lazarus Group 有关联的黑客在10月将韩国境内的30台服务器列为网络攻击的潜在目标。Cyfirma表示，该公司获取了一份由使用韩语的黑客编制的清单，涉及10个国家的216台服务器，包括政府机构、银行、电信公司和基础设施提供商。在总数中，30台服务器位于韩国。报告显示，最初的216台服务器清单于10月24日完成。按地区划分，亚太地区有148台服务器成为目标，其次是北美洲的49台和中东地区的19台。Cyfirma补充说，美国和日本合计占总数的44.4%。这家网络安全公司以“高置信度”评估称，这些黑客与Lazarus Group生态系统有关，其表面目标包括获取经济利益和从事间谍活动。Cyfirma强调，被列入目标清单并不一定意味着相关服务器已被成功攻破。该公司警告说，仅更新网站应用程序无法解决这些漏洞，并敦促管理员安装安全补丁并重启受影响的程序

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Audi Korea accelerates recovery on solid sales of redesigned A6
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Expanded lineup, new models strengthen Audi's position across multiple powertrains Audi Korea surpassed 10,000 units in cumulative sales early this month, driven by solid sales of its redesigned A6 flagship sedan and expanded vehicle lineups with diverse powertrains, the carmaker said. Audi Korea is on track for a rapid sales rebound here after it revamped its overall strategy with a focus on product portfolio expansion.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 扩充产品阵容、推出新车型，进一步巩固奥迪在多种动力总成领域的地位。汽车制造商表示，奥迪韩国凭借改款A6旗舰轿车的稳健销量以及采用多样化动力总成的扩充车型阵容，本月初累计销量突破1万辆。奥迪韩国在全面调整整体战略、重点扩大产品组合后，有望在韩国实现销量快速反弹。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Expanded lineup, new models strengthen Audi's position across multiple powertrains Audi Korea surpassed 10,000 units in cumulative sales early this month, driven by solid sales of its redesigned A6 flagship sedan and expanded vehicle lineups with diverse powertrains, the carmaker said. The sales figure was achieved a month earlier than last year, marking the second consecutive year that the German automaker has hit the 10,000-unit sales milestone in Korea. Audi Korea is on track for a rapid sales rebound here after it revamped its overall strategy with a focus on product portfolio expansion. The carmaker introduced 16 new models last year, including flagship all-electric models — the Q6 e-tron and A6 e-tron — as well as the A5 sports sedan and Q5 SUV with internal combustion engines. The A6 sedan is particularly the key sales driver for Audi Korea, with the model's sales reaching 2,241 between January and September here, according to the carmaker. The strategy is designed to give Korean customers a broader range of choices amid rapidly diversifying preferences for powertrains, body styles and driving needs. The lineup has been further strengthened this year with the addition of four new models, including the A6, A6 Black Edition, Q3 and Q5. Rather than concentrating on a single segment or powertrain, Audi Korea has continued to broaden its offering across electric and combustion-engine vehicles, sedans and SUVs, as well as performance-oriented models. This diversified approach gives customers greater flexibility in choosing a vehicle based on their individual lifestyles and driving environments. Customers considering an electric vehicle (EV) can opt for Audi’s latest EV technology, while those who continue to prefer internal combustion engines can choose models that combine familiar driving characteristics with updated technologies and design. The impact of the expanded lineup extends beyond the initial launch of new vehicles. In the premium automotive market, customers typically take time to compare models, visit showrooms and experience vehicles through test drives before making a purchase. As a result, models introduced over the past two years are increasingly contributing to Audi’s sales foundation. Reaching the 10,000-unit mark earlier than last year is a meaningful indicator of Audi Korea’s ongoing sales recovery. "The result reflects not only the number of new models introduced, but also the company’s efforts to build a more balanced product portfolio capable of addressing a wider range of customer demand," an official from Audi Korea said. The carmaker plans to build on this momentum by leveraging its expanded lineup and customer-focused experience to reinforce its position in Korea’s premium automotive market. "With an increasingly diverse portfolio spanning powertrains and vehicle segments, Audi Korea will continue to position itself as a premium carmaker offering customers more choices and strengthen the brand’s presence in the Korean market," the official said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 改款A6销售稳健，奥迪韩国加速复苏
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 扩充产品阵容、推出新车型，进一步巩固奥迪在多种动力形式市场的地位。奥迪韩国公司表示，受改款旗舰轿车A6和采用多种动力形式、阵容扩充的新车型销量拉动，该品牌于本月早些时候在韩国的累计销量突破10,000辆。这一销量比去年提前一个月实现，标志着这家德国汽车制造商连续第二年在韩国达到10,000辆的销量里程碑。奥迪韩国公司全面调整战略，将重点放在扩充产品组合后，其在韩国的销量正迅速反弹。汽车制造商去年推出了16款新车型，包括旗舰纯电车型Q6 e-tron和A6 e-tron，以及搭载内燃机的A5运动轿车和Q5 SUV。据汽车制造商介绍，A6轿车尤其已成为奥迪韩国公司的主要销量驱动力，该车型今年1月至9月在韩国的销量达到2,241辆。这项战略旨在满足韩国消费者日益多样化的动力形式、车身样式和驾驶需求，为其提供更广泛的选择。今年，随着A6、A6 Black Edition、Q3和Q5四款新车型加入，产品阵容进一步得到加强。奥迪韩国公司没有专注于单一细分市场或动力形式，而是持续拓宽涵盖电动和燃油车型、轿车和SUV以及高性能车型的产品阵容。这种多元化路线使客户能够根据个人生活方式和驾驶环境更灵活地选择车辆。考虑购买电动汽车的客户可以选择奥迪最新的电动汽车技术，而继续偏好内燃机的客户则可以选择将熟悉的驾驶特性与更新后的技术和设计相结合的车型。扩充产品阵容的影响超出了新车上市初期的范围。在豪华汽车市场，客户通常会花时间比较车型、参观展厅并通过试驾体验车辆，然后才作出购买决定。因此，过去两年推出的车型正日益成为奥迪销量基础的重要组成部分。比去年更早达到10,000辆，是奥迪韩国公司持续恢复销量的重要指标。奥迪韩国公司一名官员表示：“这一成绩不仅反映了所推出新车型的数量，也体现了公司致力于打造更加均衡的产品组合，以满足更广泛客户需求的努力。”汽车制造商计划利用这一势头，借助扩充后的产品阵容和以客户为导向的体验，进一步巩固其在韩国豪华汽车市场的地位。该官员表示：“随着覆盖不同动力形式和车型细分市场的产品组合日益丰富，奥迪韩国公司将继续把自己定位为为客户提供更多选择的豪华汽车制造商，并强化该品牌在韩国市场的影响力。”

According to a statement issued by the Zamfara State APC E-Registration Coordinator, Yusuf Idris, the attackers stormed the Lowcost Mosque in Kaura Namoda town on Sunday while congregants were observing the early-morning Subhi (Fajr) prayers.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 全进步大会党（APC）电子登记工作负责人纳西鲁·萨尼在赞法拉州考拉纳莫达地方政府辖区一座清真寺遭疑似土匪袭击期间遇害。袭击发生于凌晨。据赞法拉州APC电子登记协调员优素福·伊德里斯发表的声明，袭击者于周日凌晨闯入考拉纳莫达镇的Lowcost Mosque，当时会众正在举行晨礼（Subhi/Fajr礼拜）。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: A supervisor of the All Progressives Congress (APC) e-registration exercise, Nasiru Sani, has been killed by suspected bandits during an early-morning attack on a mosque in Kaura Namoda Local Government Area of Zamfara State. According to a statement issued by the Zamfara State APC E-Registration Coordinator, Yusuf Idris, the attackers stormed the Lowcost Mosque in Kaura Namoda town on Sunday while congregants were observing the early-morning Subhi (Fajr) prayers. The statement said Mr Sani was fatally shot during the attack, while an unconfirmed number of other worshippers were abducted by the assailants before they fled the area. In his condolence statement released on Sunday, Mr Idris expressed deep shock over the killing, describing the deceased as a dedicated member of the party’s registration team. “I received with deep shock and sadness the news of the passing away of one of my Supervisors of the APC E-Registration in Kaura Namoda Local Government Area, Hon. Nasiru Sani Kaura,” Mr Idris stated. “Hon. Nasiru Sani lost his life as a result of a bandits’ attack while performing the Subhi prayer at the Lowcost Mosque in Kaura Namoda, where he was shot dead”, he added. Residents told PREMIUM TIMES that the gunmen targeted the Low Cost residential area of Kaura Namoda town at dawn, taking advantage of the quiet morning hours to strike the mosque during prayers. Several worshippers were taken captive, sparking renewed panic among residents. Bandits had, in October, attacked Kaura Namoda town for over three hours after bypassing local vigilante fortifications via a riverine route, killing seven members of the local Joint Task Force (JTF) and abducting 38 residents. Also, in August, suspected bandits killed six soldiers and abducted over 70 residents in the Kasuwar Daji community of the LGA. However, troops later foiled another mass abduction attempt along the Unguwar Rogo axis. Intruders were found at Threod Systems in Viimsi, outside the Estonian capital, shortly after 3 a.m. on Saturday trying to break into the building with the aim of setting it on fire and causing an explosion, Prosecutor General Astrid Asi said Sunday. Writing on X , Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal said: "This is part of Russia’s broader hybrid war against Europe, with the aim of decreasing support to Ukraine and pressure on Russia. We will not be intimidated." Threod's security staff stopped the attack before it could cause significant damage, authorities said. Eight suspects, all residents of neighboring Latvia, were detained. Five have been remanded in custody. Estonia's Internal Security Service, known as KAPO, said intelligence gathered by its officers showed the attack was commissioned by Russia's GRU military intelligence agency. Threod makes long-range reconnaissance and attack drones. "We will not be intimidated. Together with our allies, we will continue supporting Ukraine and standing firm against Russian aggression," Estonia's defense ministry said in a statement on X. The latest attempt follows an August arson attack on Milrem Robotics, which supplies unmanned ground vehicles to Ukraine. Estonian authorities formally blamed Russian intelligence for that incident in September. KAPO has warned that Russia is increasingly targeting European defense manufacturers to disrupt military production and deliveries to Ukraine. The investigation into Saturday's attempted attack remains ongoing

https://www.myjoyonline.com/the-currency.summary_zh: 让我毫不含糊地说：如果已经证实所用肖像确实不是西奥多西娅·奥科赫的肖像，那么对该图像负责设计、获取和核实的人必须被解雇。如果受托承担这项职责的人连核实即将出现在本国货币上的人物肖像身份这一最基本的任务都无法完成，那么就必须严肃质疑其是否适合担任这项工作。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/the-currency.body: The introduction of a new national currency should be a moment of pride, national reflection and celebration of Ghana's identity. It should provide an opportunity to honour distinguished Ghanaians whose contributions have helped shape our history, culture and national development. Unfortunately, what should have been a moment of national pride has been overshadowed by a deeply embarrassing controversy surrounding the alleged use of an incorrect portrait of Theodosia Okoh, the distinguished Ghanaian who designed our national flag. Let me state this without mincing words: IF IT IS ESTABLISHED THAT THE PORTRAIT USED IS INDEED NOT THAT OF THEODOSIA OKOH, THEN THE PERSON RESPONSIBLE FOR THE DESIGN, SOURCING AND VERIFICATION OF THAT IMAGE MUST BE DISMISSED . This is not a small mistake. It is not an ordinary administrative oversight. It is not something that should be swept under the carpet with an apology or an explanation about institutional procedures. We are talking about the image of a national icon being printed on the currency of an entire country. How can a project of such national significance be handled with this level of apparent disregard for basic verification? What exactly was the designer doing? What research was conducted? Who supplied the photograph? Who verified its authenticity? Who examined the final artwork before it received approval? Was there no historian, researcher, communications professional or responsible official capable of identifying such a fundamental error? Are we seriously saying that an entire chain of professionals could handle the design of Ghana's national currency without establishing whether the photographs being used actually belong to the personalities being honoured? If the individual entrusted with this responsibility could not undertake the most elementary task of verifying the identity of a person whose portrait was to appear on our national currency, then serious questions must be asked about their suitability for that assignment. Public responsibility is not a ceremonial title. It comes with accountability. You cannot be entrusted with an important national assignment, deliver such a fundamental failure and expect to retain your position as though nothing happened. If the portrait is confirmed to be wrong, the person responsible for the design and verification should not merely be reprimanded, transferred or asked to apologise. They should be fired.There must be consequences proportionate to the gravity of the failure. Beyond the immediate embarrassment, this incident raises a much bigger question about the standards of due diligence in our public institutions. If something as basic as verifying a historical portrait can escape scrutiny, what confidence should the public have in the quality-control processes governing other important national assignments? However, while this alleged error deserves the strongest possible scrutiny, I find the attempt by Afenyo-Markin to use it as an indictment of the government's entire economic management rather simplistic and disproportionate. A mistake in currency design and the management of the national economy are two different responsibilities. Fiscal discipline, monetary policy, inflation management, debt sustainability and the design of banknotes are not interchangeable functions. One can condemn an administrative failure without manufacturing an argument that it automatically demonstrates an inability to manage the economy. Political criticism must be intelligent, measured and supported by sound reasoning. Not every government mistake must be stretched into an argument about everything the government does. That said, the government must not use political distractions to evade responsibility. The issue deserves a proper investigation, a transparent explanation and decisive action against anyone whose negligence is established. More importantly, we must not allow this controversy to overshadow the broader significance of recognising distinguished Ghanaians beyond the familiar personalities who have traditionally dominated our national currency. The recognition of personalities such as Theodosia Okoh and Kofi Annan, alongside Kwame Nkrumah and other notable figures, provides an opportunity to appreciate the different dimensions of Ghanaian excellence and national contribution. Our national history is bigger than any political party, family, political tradition or individual historical narrative. Ghana belongs to all of us. The national currency should reflect that reality. We must move away from the unfortunate tendency to assess national recognition through the narrow lenses of political inheritance, family connections and partisan nostalgia. The worth of a Ghanaian's contribution should be measured by what that individual gave to the country, not by their political affiliation or family background. We cannot build a culture of excellence by continually making excuses for failures that should never have happened in the first place
https://www.myjoyonline.com/the-currency.title_zh: 货币肖像闹剧：必须有人为此负责
https://www.myjoyonline.com/the-currency.body_zh: 推出一种新的国家货币，应当成为值得自豪、引发全国反思并庆祝加纳身份的时刻。它应当提供一个机会，向那些为塑造我们的历史、文化和国家发展作出贡献的杰出加纳人致敬。遗憾的是，本应成为民族自豪时刻的事情，却被一场围绕涉嫌使用错误肖像的争议蒙上阴影；该肖像人物是设计我国国旗的杰出加纳人Theodosia Okoh。让我毫不含糊地表明：如果证实所用肖像确实不是Theodosia Okoh，那么对该图像负责设计、获取和核实的人员必须被解雇。这不是一个小错误，也不是普通的行政疏忽，更不能用一句道歉或一套关于机构程序的解释来掩盖。我们谈论的是一位国家标志性人物的肖像被印在一个国家的货币上。如此具有国家意义的项目，怎么会在基本核实方面表现出如此明显的漠视？设计人员究竟在做什么？开展了哪些研究？谁提供了照片？谁核实了照片的真实性？最终 artwork 在获批前由谁审阅？难道没有任何历史学家、研究人员、传播专业人员或负责的官员能够发现如此根本性的错误吗？我们真的要说，一整条专业人员的链条在设计加纳国家货币时，竟没有确认所使用照片确实属于拟致敬的人物吗？如果受托承担这项责任的人连核实即将登上国家货币的人物肖像身份这一最基本的任务都无法完成，那么就必须对其是否适合承担这项任务提出严重质疑。公共责任不是一个礼仪性头衔，而是伴随着问责。你不能受托承担一项重要的国家任务，却犯下如此根本性的错误，然后还指望保留职位，仿佛什么都没发生。如果肖像被确认有误，负责设计和核实的人就不应仅仅受到训诫、调动或被要求道歉，而应当被解雇。后果必须与这一失误的严重程度相称。除了眼前的难堪之外，这起事件还提出了一个更大的问题：我国公共机构的尽职调查标准究竟如何？如果连核实一幅历史肖像这样基本的事情都能逃过监督，公众又该如何相信管理其他重要国家项目的质量控制流程？然而，尽管这场涉嫌错误值得最严格的审查，但我认为Afenyo-Markin试图以此全面指责政府经济治理的做法过于简单，而且失衡。货币设计上的错误与国家经济管理是两种不同的职责。财政纪律、货币政策、通胀控制、债务可持续性和钞票设计并非可以相互替代的职能。人们可以谴责行政失误，却不能生硬地认定它自动证明政府无力管理经济。政治批评必须明智、审慎，并有可靠推理作为支撑。不能把政府的每一次错误都牵强地扩大为对政府所有作为的指责。尽管如此，政府不能利用政治转移话题来逃避责任。这件事值得进行适当调查、作出透明解释，并对任何经查存在疏忽的人采取果断行动。更重要的是，我们绝不能让这场争议掩盖在国家货币上认可Theodosia Okoh和Kofi Annan等杰出加纳人，从而突破传统上长期占据我国国家货币的那些熟悉人物这一更广泛的意义。将Theodosia Okoh、Kofi Annan与Kwame Nkrumah及其他知名人物并列表彰，为我们认识加纳卓越成就和国家贡献的不同维度提供了机会。我们的国家历史比任何政党、家族、政治传统或个人历史叙事都更为宏大。加纳属于我们每一个人，国家货币应当反映这一现实。我们必须摆脱一种不幸的倾向，即以政治传承、家族关系和党派怀旧的狭隘视角来评价国家认可。衡量一位加纳人的贡献是否有价值，应当看这个人为国家付出了什么，而不是看其政治立场或家庭背景。我们不能通过不断为那些原本就不该发生的失误寻找借口，来建立卓越文化。

Unlock these with Subscription Defence Minister Rajnath Singh on Sunday (November 15, 2026) called for strengthening India’s indigenous Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) capabilities, saying the country must move beyond being a user of advanced technologies to become a developer, innovator and global leader in critical technological domains. “There can be no compromise on the integrity of testing results in strategic applications,” Mr. Singh said, stressing the need to develop indigenous capabilities in advanced inspection technologies, specialised sensors, evaluation equipment, and associated software to reduce technological dependence and secure critical defence supply chains. He said NDT technologies enable the examination of materials, components, and structures without causing damage, much like ultrasound and X-rays help examine the human body without surgical intervention. With Indian defence systems becoming increasingly sophisticated, every critical material, component, and manufacturing process must meet the highest standards of quality and reliability, he said. Hidden defects could affect operational availability, increase maintenance requirements, reduce equipment service life, and, in critical situations, jeopardise mission success. “We need to move beyond a culture of merely identifying defects towards actively preventing them by embedding quality at every stage of the manufacturing process,” he said. Underlining the strategic significance of NDT, Mr. Singh said quality in defence applications, including missiles, aircraft, naval platforms, and spacecraft, was not merely a manufacturing requirement but an essential element of operational reliability and national security. He cited India’s achievements in missile development, naval platforms, aerospace engineering, radar systems, and space applications as evidence of its expanding indigenous capabilities. The commissioning of the country’s first indigenous aircraft carrier, INS Vikrant , was an important milestone in India’s journey towards self-reliance, he said. The Defence Minister also highlighted the growing role of artificial intelligence, machine learning, robotics, advanced sensors, digital twins, and predictive analytics in improving inspection accuracy and structural health monitoring. He called for developing indigenous solutions suited to India’s strategic and industrial requirements. Referring to initiatives such as Innovations for Defence Excellence (iDEX) and the Technology Development Fund (TDF), he said collaboration among the government, industry, academia, and research institutions was crucial to technological advancement. The three-day conference has brought together over 2,000 professionals, researchers, industry experts, and students to discuss emerging NDT technologies and their applications, particularly in defence and aerospace. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/i.body_zh:
订阅还可享受高级报道、社论、观点等更多内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。

国防部长拉杰纳特·辛格于2026年11月15日星期日呼吁加强印度本土无损检测（NDT）能力，称印度必须超越先进技术使用者的角色，成为关键技术领域的开发者、创新者和全球领导者。

辛格先生说：“在战略应用中，检测结果的完整性绝不容妥协。”他强调，需要发展先进检测技术、专用传感器、评估设备及相关软件的本土能力，以降低技术依赖并保障关键国防供应链安全。

他说，无损检测技术能够在不造成损伤的情况下检查材料、零部件和结构，就像超声波和X射线能够在无需手术介入的情况下检查人体一样。

随着印度国防系统日益复杂，每一种关键材料、零部件和制造流程都必须达到最高的质量与可靠性标准。他说，潜在缺陷可能影响装备可用率、增加维护需求、缩短设备使用寿命，并在关键情况下危及任务成功。

他说：“我们需要超越仅仅识别缺陷的文化，将质量融入制造流程的每一个阶段，主动防止缺陷产生。”

辛格先生强调无损检测的战略意义，并表示，包括导弹、飞机海军平台和航天器在内的国防应用质量，不仅是一项制造要求，更是作战可靠性和国家安全的 essential 要素。

他列举印度在导弹研制、舰船平台、航空航天工程、雷达系统和空间应用方面取得的成就，作为其本土能力不断扩大的证据。

他说，该国首艘国产航空母舰“维克兰特”号入列，是印度迈向自力更生的重要里程碑。

国防部长还强调，人工智能、机器学习、机器人技术、先进传感器、数字孪生和预测分析在提高检测准确性与结构健康监测方面发挥着日益重要的作用。

他呼吁制定符合印度战略和工业需求的本土解决方案。

谈及“国防卓越创新计划”（iDEX）和技术发展基金（TDF）等举措，他说，政府、产业界、学术界和研究机构之间的协作对技术进步至关重要。

这场为期三天的会议汇集了2,000多名专业人士、研究人员、行业专家和学生，讨论新兴无损检测技术及其应用，尤其是在国防和航空航天领域的应用。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-to-op.body: President John Dramani Mahama is expected to travel to Techiman on Monday to officially open the Nadkansco Cashew Processing Factory, a GH¢148.4 million facility financed by the Ghana Export-Import Bank (GEXIM). The announcement was made by the Minister in charge of Government Communications, Felix Kwakye Ofosu, in a Facebook post, highlighting the facility's potential to create jobs, strengthen local cashew processing and support farmers. According to Mr Ofosu, an additional GH¢12 million has been provided for capacity building to support the factory's operations and enhance the skills of its workforce. The facility has an installed processing capacity of 100 metric tonnes of raw cashew nuts per day, positioning it to contribute significantly to Ghana's efforts to process more of its agricultural produce locally. At full operational capacity, the factory is expected to create 1,500 direct jobs. Mr Ofosu disclosed that 600 workers are currently undergoing training in preparation for the facility's operations. The factory is also expected to support the livelihoods of thousands of cashew farmers through its outgrower network, which comprises 6,000 farmers. Of these, 1,200 have received training funded by GEXIM to improve their capacity and support the supply of raw materials to the processing facility

Unlock these with Subscription Switzerland Tourism is expanding its strategic focus on south India, driven by rising travel demand and enhanced direct air connectivity between Bengaluru and Zurich, said Martin Nydegger, chief executive officer of Switzerland Tourism. Speaking during a recent visit to the city, he highlighted the southern hub’s growing significance within the national tourism board’s long-term international expansion strategy. For Switzerland Tourism, holidaymakers and business travellers from Karnataka and south India currently account for a market share of 14.1% and 28.4%, respectively. The shift coincides with the introduction of a new direct route by Swiss International Air Lines, operating five times a week between Bengaluru and Zurich starting at the end of October. To mark the expansion and increase regional awareness, the tourism authority named Indian cricketer Smriti Mandhana as a brand ambassador. “India remains among the primary target markets for Swiss tourism, with official projections aiming for 8,00,000 overnight stays from the country by 2030,” Mr. Nydegger told The Hindu emphasising that future market growth would focus heavily on qualitative development rather than pure visitor numbers. A central element of this approach is corporate and incentive travel, which accounts for roughly 20% of all Indian overnight stays in Switzerland. Tourism officials view a balanced mix of corporate and leisure travel, particularly outside peak holiday periods, as essential for maintaining sustainable destination operations. Addressing broader industry trends, Mr. Nydegger noted that while international tourism continues to experience organic growth compared to other economic sectors, destinations must move away from volume-driven expansion towards precise, personalised marketing strategies. To manage this transition, Switzerland Tourism has introduced its “Travel Better” framework, an operational strategy designed to guide visitor engagement through five core pillars. The strategy promotes all-year tourism by highlighting distinct seasonal offerings, including an extended, warmer autumn season, and uses data tracking to optimise visitor flow by pairing popular hotspots with lesser-known destinations. According to Mr. Nydegger, it also encourages longer stays for deeper cultural immersion and integrates eco-friendly practices under a programme known as “Swisstainable,” where thousands of local hotels, restaurants, and mountain railways participate to embed sustainability into standard services. The framework is also equipped to address public space management, balancing tourist activities with community infrastructure and the shared use of local spaces, he added. 瑞士旅游局正在扩大其对印度南部的战略关注，重点是提升旅游需求以及加强班加罗尔与苏黎世之间的直飞航空连接。瑞士旅游局首席执行官Martin Nydegger表示：“在出行需求增长以及班加罗尔与苏黎世直飞航线改善的推动下，我们正加强对印度南部的战略布局。”

Nydegger先生 recently visiting the city 期间表示，这座南部枢纽城市在国家旅游局长期国际扩张战略中的重要性日益凸显。对瑞士旅游局而言，目前来自卡纳塔克邦和印度南部的度假游客及商务旅客分别占市场份额的14.1%和28.4%。

这一转变恰逢瑞士国际航空推出新直飞航线。该航线自10月底起在班加罗尔与苏黎世之间每周运营5班。为庆祝业务拓展并提高地区认知度，旅游局还任命印度板球运动员Smriti Mandhana为品牌大使。

Nydegger先生告诉《The Hindu》：“印度仍是瑞士旅游业的重点目标市场之一，官方预计到2030年来自该国的游客过夜住宿量将达到8,00,000晚。”他强调，未来市场增长将重点关注品质提升，而非单纯追求游客数量。

这一方针的核心组成部分是企业旅行和奖励旅行。目前，来自印度的所有过夜住宿中，企业旅行和奖励旅行约占20%。旅游官员认为，企业旅行与休闲旅行的均衡组合，尤其是在假日高峰期之外拓展业务，对于维持旅游目的地可持续运营至关重要。

谈及更广泛的行业趋势，Nydegger先生指出，尽管与其他经济部门相比，国际旅游业仍在持续实现自然增长，但旅游目的地必须摆脱以客流量为导向的扩张模式，转向精准、个性化的营销策略。

为管理这一转型，瑞士旅游局推出了“Travel Better”框架。这是一项旨在通过五大核心支柱引导游客互动的运营战略。该战略通过突出各季节的特色产品，包括延长且气候较温暖的秋季，来推动全年旅游；同时利用数据追踪，将热门景点与 lesser-known destinations 搭配，以优化游客流动。

Nydegger先生表示，该战略还鼓励游客延长停留时间，以更深入地体验当地文化，并将环保实践纳入一项名为“Swisstainable”的计划。目前已有数千家当地酒店、餐厅和山区铁路参与其中，将可持续发展融入标准服务。

他还补充称，这一框架也能够处理公共空间管理问题，在旅游活动、社区基础设施和当地公共空间共享之间取得平衡。

https://punchng.com/fire-razes-shops-at-.summary_zh: 周日上午，拉各斯州 Synagogue 一带的Ikotun市场发生火灾，多家店铺被夷为平地，消防员奋战控制火势。拉各斯州消防与救援局在X平台发布的声明中表示，该局于上午10:24接到紧急求助。该局发布的视频画面显示，建筑结构被烧焦、金属屋顶坍塌，混凝土瓦砾散落，市场摊位内烟雾弥漫；消防员穿过受损建筑，努力控制火势。
https://punchng.com/fire-razes-shops-at-.body: Fire has razed shops at Ikotun Market, along Synagogue in Lagos State, with firefighters battling to contain the blaze on Sunday morning. In a statement posted on its X handle, the Lagos State Fire and Rescue Service said it received an emergency call at 10:24 am. It said firefighters from the Ejigbo and Isolo fire stations arrived at the scene at 10:36 am to contain the fire. Video footage released by the service showed charred structures, collapsed metal roofing, concrete debris and smoke-filled market stalls, as firefighters moved through the damaged buildings to contain the fire. The service did not immediately provide details on the cause of the fire. Lagos denies N700m billboard fee, says highest advert costs N10m monthly NDLEA intercepts 25kg meth hidden in breakfast cereal from South Africa United Nigeria Airlines backs Traders Cup However, in an update, the Lagos State Traffic Management Authority confirmed that there was “no casualty recorded at the moment” and said, “concerted efforts are ongoing to completely extinguish the fire.” “As a result of the incident, the entire lane inward Synagogue is completely blocked to vehicular movement, and contraflow has been adopted to ease traffic in the axis,” LASTMA said. The incident is the latest in a series of fire outbreaks in Lagos in recent days and weeks. On Saturday, November 14, firefighters from the Sari Iganmu and Isolo stations responded to a blaze that affected the top floor of a one-storey residential building at No. 9, Ola Market in Adedeji, Itire, Surulere. The fire was confined to its origin with no casualties reported.
